## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `pnpm --dir js-ds-ui quality:check`
- [ ] I ran component tests (`pnpm --filter @js-ds-ui/components test -- --run`)
- [ ] I updated docs and/or migration notes when behavior changed
- [ ] I validated accessibility impact (keyboard/ARIA/focus behavior)
- [ ] I checked visual impact for UI changes

## Risk

## Rollout / Migration Notes
